name: Samuel Okonkwo
psychographics: Pragmatic multitasker who values efficiency over tradition; believes a well-fed family is a happy family, but refuses to let dietary rules dictate his social life.
current_solutions: The Family Plate app (basic meal planning) and WhatsApp groups with his mother-in-law for recipe swaps. He also relies on ingredient labels from local supermarkets like ShopRite.
frustration: Last Tuesday at 6:14 PM, he tried to make stir-fry for the kids after a late meeting. The 12-year-old has a severe peanut allergy. He realized the 'peanut-free' sauce he bought from the market had 'may contain traces' labeling. He had to throw the whole dinner away and order expensive pizza instead, wasting ₦4,500 and an hour of his evening.
decision_style: Compares ingredient lists on his phone while standing in the aisle; if a product isn't clearly labeled within 30 seconds, he puts it back and grabs a known safe brand, even if it costs more.
voice: Direct and business-like, mixes Pidgin English with tech terms. 'So I just check the label quick, you know? If it vague, I just skip am. No stress, but annoying when market no clear.'
